title: Ruthless Bar Salts Grape Heads On Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Ruthless Bar Salts Grape Heads on Ice delivers a bold and juicy Grape flavour with a crisp menthol twist. The deep, candy-like sweetness of ripe Grapes is balanced by a subtle tang, creating a rich yet refreshing profile. A cooling menthol finish enhances the experience, making each inhale smooth and satisfyingly chilled. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid is optimised for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices, ensuring a well-balanced vape with consistent flavour and vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation provides a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, making it an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy fruity profiles with a cool exhale. Ruthless are one of the most influential brands in American e-liquids, known for crafting bold and unique flavours that have inspired the industry for years. Their expertly blended shortfills and nic salts continue to be a favourite among vapers on both sides of the pond who prize high-quality, distinct and flavourful e-liquids that push the boundaries of what’s possible in vape juice.
